title: Duality exchanges Bob's vector with Alice's reversed vector
statement: Fix a positive integer $n$ and let $\omega$ be a hard sample on the $n$ coordinates. Then Bob's full input vector of the dualized sample equals the coordinate reversal of Alice's full input vector of $\omega$: for every coordinate the value Bob receives after dualizing agrees with the value Alice receives at the mirror-image coordinate of the original sample.
hypotheses_covered: n is a positive natural number
ω is a hard sample on the n coordinates
replaced: Bob's full input vector in the dual is Alice's original full vector in reverse order.
